jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.

Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du berätst kundenorientiert und verkaufst unser vielfältiges Warensortiment, zum
Beispiel bei der Geschenkauswahl

• Du kümmerst dich um die Kassiervorgänge und sorgst für eine präzise und korrekte Abrechnung

• Du präsentierst das erlesene Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiment auf eine geschmackvolle einladende Weise

• Du setzt unsere hohen Qualitätsstandards mit Hingabe und Sorgfalt um

• Du achtest auf die Einhaltung des Hygiene- und Frischekonzepts

Das bringst du mit
Du bringst wertvolle Berufserfahrung im Detailhandel mit und hast eine echte Leidenschaft für den Verkauf.
Du liebst es, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden eine besondere Freude zu bereiten und ihnen ein einzigartiges Einkaufserlebnis zu bieten.
Du stellst auch in turbulenten Zeiten höchste Qualität und Kundenorientierung stets an erste Stelle und überzeugst durch ein ausgeprägtes Bewusstsein für Details sowie für Premium-Produkte und -Services.
Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, bist ein echter Teamplayer und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.
Du fühlst dich in einem lebhaften Umfeld wohl und packst auch bei körperlich anspruchsvollen Tätigkeiten tatkräftig mit an.
Du schätzt eine offene und respektvolle Kommunikation und beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher; Kenntnisse in Französisch und weiteren Sprachen sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil.
Du bist flexibel einsetzbar und schätzt ein Arbeitsumfeld mit wechselnden Einsatztagen – unser Betrieb ist sieben Tage pro Woche von 09.00 bis 18.00 Uhr geöffnet und umfasst mindestens vier Wochenendeinsätze pro Monat.
Du hast keine Scheu vor Einsätzen an Wochenenden und Feiertagen – an 364 Tagen im Jahr sind wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden da.

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Cornelia De Col, Filialleitung, +41 55 645 44 13, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

jobs.title: IT-Projektleiter HR- & Corporate-Service-Applikationen (w/m/d)

titleByLocale.it: IT-Projektleiter Risorse Umane- & Corporate-Service-Applikationen (w/m/d)
titleByLocale.en: IT Project Manager HR & Corporate Service Applications (f/m/d)
titleByLocale.fr: IT-Projektleiter HR- & Corporate-Service-Applikationen (w/m/d)

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, kreative Ideen.
In unserem Unternehmensbereich «Corporate Functions» sind verschiedene Tätigkeiten gebündelt. Neben unseren Finance- und IT-Services sind in diesem Bereich auch das globale Marketing und Sales Management sowie Human Resources angesiedelt. Täglich entstehen hier frische Ideen, die wir gemeinsam zum Erfolg führen. Eigenverantwortung und vernetztes Arbeiten sind uns besonders wichtig. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Planung, Steuerung und Umsetzung von IT-Projekten im Umfeld von HR-Applikationen (z. B. SAP SuccessFactors, Payroll, Time Tracking, Recruiting, Learning) sowie Corporate-Service-Applikationen (z. B. Finance, Legal, Facility Management, Collaboration Tools)

• Du identifizierst proaktiv Risiken, Abhängigkeiten und Optimierungspotenziale entlang der End-to-End-Prozesse (Hire-to-Retire, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report etc.)

• Du arbeitest eng mit HR, Finance und Corporate Functions zusammen und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in nachhaltige IT-Lösungen

• Du steuerst interne und externe Partner (z. B. Implementierungspartner, SaaS-Provider)

• Du etablierst und entwickelst agile Projekt- und Delivery-Modelle weiter (Scrum, Kanban, hybride Ansätze)

• Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität, Integrationsstabilität und User Experience über Systemgrenzen hinweg sicher

• Du kommunizierst Projekte und Stakeholder transparent bis auf Management- und Board-Ebene

• Du planst und führst Release-, Change- und Go-Live-Aktivitäten inklusive Business Readiness und Adoption-Massnahmen durch

• Du verbesserst kontinuierlich Projektmethoden, Governance-Strukturen und Toolsets

• Du stellst die Einhaltung von Compliance-, Datenschutz- und Security-Vorgaben sicher (z. B. DSGVO, SOX, Audit-Anforderungen)

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation sowie mehrjährige Erfahrung als IT-Projektleiter im Umfeld von HR-IT und/oder Corporate-Service-Applikationen

• Du verfügst über ein sehr gutes Verständnis für HR- und Corporate-Prozesse sowie deren IT-seitige Abbildung und hast Erfahrung mit SaaS-Lösungen, Integrationsszenarien und komplexen Stakeholder-Landschaften

• Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in agilen und klassischen Projektmanagement-Methoden (Scrum, Kanban, PMI, PRINCE2, SAFe) und setzt diese situativ ein

• Du arbeitest hands-on, übernimmst hohe Eigenverantwortung und überzeugst mit Umsetzungsstärke sowie einer strukturierten, analytischen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise

• Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und kommunizierst sicher mit Fachbereichen, IT und Management

• Du denkst proaktiv voraus, treibst Themen eigenständig voran und reagierst flexibel auf Veränderungen sowie Transformations- und Digitalisierungsinitiativen

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Kostenlose Parkplätze

• Vergünstigungen im Läderach Café und Personalrestaurant

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Name Vorname, Position, Telefonnummer, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

jobs.description:
Hochwertige frische Schokolade – dafür steht die Schweizer Schokoladenmanufaktur Läderach. 1962 gegründet, beschäftigt das Familienunternehmen heute gruppenweit über 2500 Menschen aus mehr als 80 Ländern, Tendenz steigend. Der Hauptsitz des Unternehmens liegt im Kanton Glarus. Vor malerischer Alpenkulisse produzieren wir hier unsere frischen Schokoladen und entwickeln in agilen Teams ständig neue, innovative Ideen.
Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 250 Chocolaterien in über 30 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben.

Nun schreiben wir ein neues Kapitel: Mit der Neueröffnung unseres ersten Outlets in der Schweiz schaffen wir einen weiteren Ort, an dem Schokoladenliebhaberinnen und-liebhaber die Welt von Läderach entdecken können. Willst auch du daran teilhaben? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du unterstützt die Filialleitung bei der täglichen Führung und Organisation der Filiale

• Du bietest eine kompetente, kundenorientierte Beratung und unterstützt bei der Auswahl von Geschenken aus unserem vielfältigen Warensortiment

• Du sorgst für die ansprechende Präsentation unseres umfangreichen Confiserie- und Schokoladensortiments, unter anderem durch kreative Ladengestaltung

• Du garantierst Spitzenqualität und setzt unsere hohen Standards konsequent um

• Du bist eine wichtige Ansprechperson für das Team und für die Kundinnen und Kunden

• Du trägst zur Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen bei und stellst sicher, dass die Filiale effizient und profitabel arbeitet

Das bringst du mit

• Du hast eine Ausbildung im Detailhandel abgeschlossen und/oder bringst
vergleichbare Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Lebensmitteln mit

• Du bringst erste Führungserfahrung im Fashion Retail mit, vorzugsweise von grösseren Teams

• Du hast bereits mit Schokolade gearbeitet

• Du liebst eine Hands-on-Mentalität und bist technisch affin

• Du bist optimierungsfreudig und verfügst über ein unternehmerisches Denken

• Du hast ein ausserordentliches Qualitäts- und Hygienebewusstsein

• Du schätzt eine offene und respektvolle Kommunikation und beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch sicher; Kenntnisse in Französisch und weiteren Sprachen sind ein zusätzlicher Vorteil

• Du hast keine Scheu vor flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und bist auch an Wochenenden, Samstagen, Sonntagen oder Feiertagen voll dabei

Das bieten wir dir

• Ein spannendes Arbeitsumfeld mit motivierten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

• Eine Position mit viel Eigenverantwortung

• Die Möglichkeit, frische Ideen einzubringen

• Eine offene und respektvolle Feedbackkultur

• Interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Grosszügige Rabatte auf unsere Produkte

• Schokolade am Arbeitsplatz

• Gute Erreichbarkeit der Standorte

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

Klingt interessant? Dann bewirb dich bei uns. Franziska Franz, Regionale Verkaufsleiterin, +41 79 521 61 88, steht dir bei Fragen gern zur Verfügung.

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass wir bei der Besetzung dieser Position keine externen Personalvermittlungen berücksichtigen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità: questo è ciò che rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, l’azienda a conduzione familiare impiega ora oltre 2.500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi del gruppo e la tendenza è in aumento. La sede dell'azienda si trova nel cantone di Glarona. Produciamo qui i nostri cioccolatini freschi in un pittoresco scenario alpino e sviluppiamo costantemente idee nuove e innovative in team agili. La divisione “Retail” comprende oltre 250 cioccolaterie in oltre 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità al cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a provare ancora e ancora il cioccolato fresco. Ora stiamo scrivendo un nuovo capitolo: con l'apertura del nostro primo punto vendita in Svizzera, stiamo creando un altro luogo dove gli amanti del cioccolato possono scoprire il mondo di Läderach. Vuoi partecipare anche tu? Allora vieni da noi. Questo è ciò che vi aspetta
• Sostenete la direzione della filiale nella gestione quotidiana e nell'organizzazione della filiale
• Offrite consulenza competente e orientata al cliente e la supportate nella scelta di regali dalla nostra vasta gamma di prodotti
• Assicurate una presentazione attraente della nostra vasta gamma di dolciumi e cioccolato, anche attraverso un design creativo del negozio
• Garantite la massima qualità e implementate coerentemente i nostri elevati standard
• Siete un importante interlocutore per il team e per i clienti
• Contribuite all'ottimizzazione dei processi di lavoro e assicuratevi che la filiale funzioni in modo efficiente e redditizio Cosa portate con voi
• Avete completato la formazione nella vendita al dettaglio e/o hai un'esperienza comparabile nel trattare con il cibo
• Hai un'esperienza gestionale iniziale nel commercio al dettaglio di moda, preferibilmente in team più grandi
• Hai già lavorato con il cioccolato
• Ami una mentalità pratica e sei tecnicamente esperto
• Sei desideroso di ottimizzare e hai una mentalità imprenditoriale
• Hai una straordinaria consapevolezza della qualità e dell'igiene
• Apprezzi la comunicazione aperta e rispettosa e hai una padronanza sicura del tedesco e dell'inglese; La conoscenza del francese e di altre lingue è un ulteriore vantaggio
• Non hai paura degli orari di lavoro flessibili e sei pienamente coinvolto anche nei fine settimana, sabato, domenica e nei giorni festivi Questo è ciò che ti offriamo
• Un ambiente di lavoro entusiasmante con colleghi motivati ​​• Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale
• L'opportunità di introdurre nuove idee
• Una cultura del feedback aperta e rispettosa
• Formazione interna ed esterna
• Opportunità di carriera individuali
• Generosi sconti sui nostri prodotti
• Cioccolato al lavoro
• Facile accesso alle sedi Possiedilo. Coltivalo. Rendilo fresco. Sembra interessante? Allora rivolgiti a noi. Franziska Franz, Regional Sales Manager, +41 79 521 61 88, sarà felice di rispondere a qualsiasi domanda tu possa avere. Chiediamo la vostra comprensione sul fatto che non prendiamo in considerazione agenzie di reclutamento esterne quando ricopriamo questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that’s what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are in the canton of Glarus. We produce our fresh chocolates here against a picturesque Alpine backdrop and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The “Retail” division includes over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Now we are writing a new chapter: With the opening of our first outlet in Switzerland, we are creating another place where chocolate lovers can discover the world of Läderach. Do you also want to take part? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You support the branch management in the daily management and organization of the branch
• You offer competent, customer-oriented advice and support in the selection of gifts from our diverse range of goods
• You ensure the attractive presentation of our extensive confectionery and chocolate range, including through creative store design
• You guarantee top quality and consistently implement our high standards
• You are an important contact person for the team and for the customers
• You contribute to the Optimize work processes and ensure that the branch works efficiently and profitably What you bring with you
• You have completed training in retail and/or have comparable experience in dealing with food
• You have initial management experience in fashion retail, preferably in larger teams
• You have already worked with chocolate
• You love a hands-on mentality and are technically savvy
• You are keen to optimize and have an entrepreneurial mindset
• You have an extraordinary Quality and hygiene awareness
• You value open and respectful communication and have a confident command of German and English; Knowledge of French and other languages is an additional advantage
• You are not afraid of flexible working hours and are also fully involved on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Easy access to the locations Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Franziska Franz, Regional Sales Manager, +41 79 521 61 88, will be happy to answer any questions you may have. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The “Retail” division comprises more than 250 chocolateries in more than 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us. This is what awaits you. You lead and motivate a dedicated team of branch employees
• You ensure the efficient organization and smooth operation of the branch operation
• You offer competent, customer-oriented advice and support in the selection of gifts from our diverse product range
• You provide an attractive presentation of our extensive range of confiseries and chocolate, including creative shop design. You take on the responsibility for numbers, ensure the proper handling of cash transactions and guarantee a correct settlement
• You take care of the ordering process and make sure that there are always enough goods available
• You ensure that our hygiene and freshness concept is adhered to at all times
• You take over the personnel planning in shift operations and are actively involved in the recruitment process You bring that with you. You bring several years of sales and leadership experience in the retail trade and are characterized by a high level of social competence and a strong leader
• You have successfully completed an apprenticeship in the retail trade and/or comparable experience in dealing with food
• You always put the highest quality and customer orientation at the top, even in turbulent times You like to take responsibility, think proactively in the team and promote positive cooperation
• You have in-depth IT knowledge and enjoy working independently and solution-oriented
• You value open and respectful communication and master German and English safely; Knowledge of French and other languages is an added advantage
• You are not afraid of flexible working hours and are also ready to take responsibility on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays This is what we offer you. An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Good accessibility of the Own it locations. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Franziska Franz, Regional Sales Manager, +41 79 521 61 88, is at your disposal for any questions. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are in the canton of Glarus. We produce our fresh chocolates here against a picturesque Alpine backdrop and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams. Various activities are bundled in our “Corporate Functions” division. In addition to our finance and IT services, global marketing and sales management as well as human resources are also located in this area. Fresh ideas are created here every day, and together we lead them to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to take part? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• As an HR business partner, you will support our retail business in Switzerland and will be the first point of contact for our regional managers, store managers and employees in our branches
• You will support managers in all HR topics along the employee lifecycle - from recruiting and onboarding to talent development through to performance management and succession planning
• You will support managers in personnel and organizational issues and provide them with competent advice on labor law and HR-related topics
• You will work closely with the areas of Talent Acquisition, HR Services, Payroll and Learning & Development together and ensure the efficient implementation of all HR-relevant topics
• You support labor law issues, absence management and the implementation of HR initiatives in the branches
• You accompany change processes and support the further development of our managers and teams
• You actively contribute your own ideas to continuously develop our HR processes and the employee experience in the retail environment
• Your focus is on supporting our retail business in Switzerland. In addition, if necessary, you will support international retail markets with selected HR initiatives, projects and operational issues What you bring with you
• You have in-depth training in human resources, business administration or a related field - ideally supplemented by further training in HR management
• You have several years of experience as an HR business partner in a dynamic retail, hospitality or service environment
• You have in-depth knowledge of Swiss labor law and feel comfortable in an operational and at the same time strategic environment
• You work independent, pragmatic and solution-oriented and keep an overview even in a fast-moving environment
• You impress with your open, empathetic and trustworthy personality as well as your strong consulting skills
• You are digitally savvy and have experience with HR systems as well as an interest in process optimization and HR digitalization
• You speak German and French fluently and have very good knowledge of English. Knowledge of Italian is an advantage This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external further training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Free parking
• Discounts in the Läderach Café and staff restaurant Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that’s what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business now employs over 2,500 people from more than 80 countries across the group, and the trend is rising. The company's headquarters are in the canton of Glarus. We produce our fresh chocolates here against a picturesque Alpine backdrop and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The “Retail” division includes over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. Do you also want to take part? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You lead and motivate a dedicated team of branch employees
• You ensure the efficient organization and smooth running of branch operations
• You offer competent, customer-oriented advice and support in the selection of gifts from our diverse range of goods
• You ensure the attractive presentation of our extensive confectionery and chocolate range, including through creative store design
• You take responsibility for the numbers, take care of the proper processing of checkout processes and guarantee correct billing
• You take care of the ordering process and ensure that sufficient goods are always available
• You ensure that our hygiene and freshness concept is adhered to at all times
• You take over personnel planning in shift operations and are actively involved in the recruiting process What you bring with you
• You have several years of sales and management experience in the retail trade and are characterized by a high level of social skills and a strong leadership personality
• You have successfully completed training in the retail trade and/or comparable experience in dealing with food
• You always give top priority to the highest quality and customer orientation, even in turbulent times
• You like to take responsibility, think proactively in a team and promote positive collaboration
• You have sound IT knowledge and like to work independently and in a solution-oriented manner
• You value open and respectful communication and have a confident command of German and English; Knowledge of French and other languages is an additional advantage
• You are not afraid of flexible working hours and are willing to take on responsibility even on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate at work
• Good accessibility of the locations Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Loredana Cordaro, Regional Sales Manager, +41 55 645 77 75, will be happy to answer any questions you may have. • You support photo and video recordings for new products, seasonal themes, events and other marketing activities
• You work closely with colleagues from marketing, social media and brand management as well as our Chief Innovation Officer
• You are willing to travel - within Switzerland and internationally This is what you bring with you
• You have several years of experience as a content creator, videographer, photographer or in a comparable creative role
• You have demonstrable experience in photography and videography, ideally in the food, lifestyle or premium consumer goods sectors, and have a meaningful portfolio
• You have mastered professional camera, lighting and Audio setups and can produce content independently
• You work confidently with Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere Pro, Lightroom, Photoshop; After Effects is an advantage) and ideally with other editing tools such as CapCut, Canva or Final Cut
• You know the requirements of modern social media platforms and understand how content works for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts and other digital channels
• You have a strong sense of storytelling, imagery, trends and visual brand communication
• You work independently, organized and with a high level of initiative and impresses with a high level of quality awareness and attention to detail
• You are enthusiastic about social media, digital trends and creative content production

• A position with a lot of personal responsibility

Cioccolato fresco di alta qualità: questo è ciò che rappresenta il produttore svizzero di cioccolato Läderach. La sede dell'azienda si trova nel cantone di Glarona. Produciamo qui i nostri cioccolatini freschi in uno scenario alpino pittoresco e sviluppiamo costantemente idee nuove e creative in team agili. Oltre ai nostri servizi finanziari e IT, in quest'area si trovano anche il marketing globale, la gestione delle vendite e le risorse umane. • Guidarai il team di supporto IT Retail con tre IT Retail Supporters e un Technical Product Owner per i sistemi IT dei nostri negozi in termini di competenze e personale

• Siete responsabili dell'implementazione di nuove soluzioni IT della filiale e della relativa formazione per i direttori dei negozi

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate – that is what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family business today employs more than 3000 people from more than 80 countries across the Group, and the trend is rising. The company’s headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In front of a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, creative ideas in agile teams. Various activities are bundled in our Corporate Functions division. In addition to our finance and IT services, this area also includes global marketing and sales management as well as human resources. Every day fresh ideas are created here, which together we lead to success. Personal responsibility and networked work are particularly important to us. Do you also want to participate? Then come to us. This is what awaits you
• You will lead the IT Retail Support Team with three IT Retail Supporters and a Technical Product Owner for our Store IT systems in terms of expertise and personnel
• Ensure effective, efficient and service-oriented 1st and 2nd level support for our more than 150 stores
• You are responsible for personnel planning including Pikett service, which you take over at regular intervals yourself
• You coordinate the IT-side opening of new branches and conversions in existing markets in Europe, acting as the central interface between retail, external partners and internal IT teams.
• By regularly carrying out IT health checks, you ensure that the branch equipment is ready for use at any time and works optimally.
• You are responsible for the rollout of new branch IT solutions and carry out the associated training for Store Managers
• You actively promote the professional and personal development of your team members You bring that with you
• You have completed training in the IT sector or a comparable qualification as well as ideally a further training in leadership (Federal certificate or equivalent)
• You have at least five years of leadership experience in a retail, hospitality or similar decentralized IT environment and have a sound understanding of typical retail IT systems (e.g. network, POS, peripherals)
• You distinguish yourself through an independent, reliable and solution-oriented working method with a strong customer and service orientation
• You are ready to travel within Europe and have a category B driving licence
• You can express yourself stylishly in German and speak fluent English
• You live and promote an inclusive, respectful and diverse cooperation – in the sense of the Charter of Läderach This is what we offer you
• An exciting working environment with motivated colleagues
• A position with a lot of personal responsibility
• The opportunity to bring in fresh ideas
• An open and respectful feedback culture
• Internal and external training
• Individual career opportunities
• Generous discounts on our products
• Chocolate in the workplace
• Free parking
• Discounts in Läderach Café and staff restaurant Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Fabio Ferramosca, Talent Acquisition Partner, is at your disposal for any questions. We ask for your understanding that we do not consider external recruitment agencies when filling this position.

descriptionByLocale.it: Cioccolato fresco e di alta qualità – questo è ciò che rappresenta la manifattura svizzera di cioccolato Läderach. Fondata nel 1962, oggi l'azienda familiare impiega oltre 2500 persone provenienti da più di 80 paesi, con una tendenza in aumento. La sede centrale dell'azienda si trova nel Canton Glarus. Con il pittoresco scenario alpino, produciamo qui le nostre cioccolate fresche e sviluppiamo costantemente nuove idee innovative in team agili. L'area aziendale «Retail» comprende oltre 250 cioccolaterie in più di 30 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo i clienti a vivere sempre di nuovo l'esperienza di assaggiare cioccolato fresco. Vuoi farne parte? Allora vieni da noi. Questo ti aspetta - Vai attivamente incontro ai nostri clienti e entusiasma per il nostro atelier walk-in - Consigli i nostri clienti con cordialità e competenza – e aiutali a trovare il regalo giusto per loro nel nostro assortimento di alta qualità - Avvicini attivamente i nostri prodotti: con un campionamento mirato direttamente sul posto, secondo le direttive e gli standard di qualità di Läderach - Fai in modo che il nostro stand natalizio sia pronto per la giornata – iniziando la mattina aiutando a sistemare e la sera aiutando a pulire - Gestisci in modo affidabile le operazioni di cassa e ti occupi di un corretto calcolo del totale - Rispetti le nostre direttive su igiene e freschezza e contribuisci con il tuo impegno a un'esperienza di acquisto coerente e curata - Lavori in turni secondo il piano di impiego Questo è ciò che porti con te - Esperienza lavorativa preziosa nel commercio al dettaglio o come promotore e una vera passione per la vendita - Entusiasmi i nostri clienti con il tuo stile entusiasta e coinvolgente - Ami fare una gioia speciale ai nostri clienti e offrire loro un'esperienza di acquisto unica - Metti sempre al primo posto la massima qualità e l'orientamento al cliente, anche in tempi turbolenti - Accetti volentieri responsabilità, sei un vero giocatore di squadra e lavori a mano con i tuoi colleghi - Valuti una comunicazione aperta e rispettosa e parli correntemente tedesco e inglese; conoscenze di francese e altre lingue sono un vantaggio ulteriore - Non hai paura di orari di lavoro flessibili e sei pronto a lavorare anche nei fine settimana, sabato, domenica o giorni festivi Questo è ciò che ti offriamo - Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante con colleghi motivati - Una posizione con molta responsabilità personale - La possibilità di portare avanti idee fresche - Una cultura del feedback aperta e rispettosa - Formazione interna ed esterna - Opportunità di carriera individuali - Sconti generosi sui nostri prodotti - Cioccolato sul posto di lavoro - Buona accessibilità delle sedi Sembra interessante? Allora candidati presso di noi. Jessica Carvalho, direttrice di filiale, +41 442 101 11 60, è a disposizione per rispondere alle tue domande. Preghiamo di comprendere che non consideriamo agenzie di lavoro esterne per la copertura di questa posizione.
descriptionByLocale.en: High-quality, fresh chocolate – that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company today employs over 2500 people from more than 80 countries, with a growing trend. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. Against a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and constantly develop new, innovative ideas in agile teams. The «Retail» business unit includes over 250 chocolateries in over 30 countries. Here, we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. This is what you can expect - You actively approach our customers and excite them about our walk-in atelier - You advise our customers with friendliness and competence – and help them find the right gift from our high-quality assortment - You actively bring our fine products closer: with targeted sampling directly on site, in accordance with Läderach's specifications and quality standards - You ensure that our Christmas stand is ready for the day – by helping in the morning with setting up and in the evening with cleaning up - You reliably take over cash transactions and ensure correct billing - You observe our hygiene and freshness requirements and contribute to a harmonious and well-groomed shopping experience with your commitment - You work in shifts according to the deployment plan This is what you bring with you - Valuable work experience in retail or as a promoter and a genuine passion for sales - You inspire our customers with your enthusiastic and infectious style - You love making a special joy for our customers and offering them a unique shopping experience - You always put the highest quality and customer orientation first, even in turbulent times - You willingly accept responsibility, are a true team player and work hand in hand with your colleagues - You appreciate open and respectful communication and speak German and English fluently; knowledge of French and other languages is an additional advantage - You have no fear of flexible working hours and are also on board on weekends, Saturdays, Sundays or public holidays This is what we offer you - A stimulating work environment with motivated colleagues - A position with a lot of personal responsibility - The opportunity to bring forward fresh ideas - An open and respectful feedback culture - Internal and external training - Individual career opportunities - Generous discounts on our products - Chocolate at the workplace - Good accessibility of the locations Sounds interesting? Then apply with us. Jessica Carvalho, branch manager, +41 442 101 11 60, is available to answer your questions. We kindly request that you understand that we do not consider external personnel agencies for the filling of this position.

descriptionByLocale.en:
High-quality fresh chocolate - that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company now employs over 2500 people worldwide, from more than 80 countries, with a growing trend. The company's headquarters are located in the Canton of Glarus. In a picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates and develop new, creative ideas in agile teams. In our production, we produce fresh wrappers from high-quality raw materials. Subsequently, we process and refine the liquid chocolates in our chocolate manufactory to create FrischSchoggi, pralines, truffles, figures and much more. You will have the unique opportunity to follow an advanced training in one of our modern production facilities in the field of Confectionery. Our experienced experts will accompany you step by step and teach you the necessary skills to be a success in the world of high-end confectionery art. Immerse yourself in a world full of creativity and precision and take advantage of the opportunity to expand your knowledge and skills to the highest level. • What we offer: An exciting advanced training with motivated colleagues The opportunity to explore further areas of the company The possibility of introducing new ideas An open and respectful feedback culture Generous discounts on our products Chocolate at the workplace Good accessibility of the sites Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply with us. Jolanda Stgier, Advanced Training Confectionery, +41 55 645 44 25, is happy to answer any questions you may have.

descriptionByLocale.fr: La manufacture suisse de chocolat Läderach est connue pour sa haute qualité de chocolat frais. Le siège social de l'entreprise se trouve dans le canton de Glaris. Dans un paysage alpin pittoresque, nous produisons nos chocolats frais et développons de nouvelles idées créatives dans des équipes agiles. Dans notre production, nous produisons des enveloppes fraîches à partir de matières premières de haute qualité. Ensuite, nous traitons et affinons les chocolats liquides dans notre manufacture de chocolat pour créer FrischSchoggi, pralines, truffes, figures et bien plus encore. Vous aurez l'opportunité unique de suivre une formation de perfectionnement dans l'une de nos modernes installations de production dans le domaine de la Confiserie. De cette façon, vous ne seulement serez pas introduit en profondeur à l'art de la confiserie, mais vous aurez également une vision pratique de tous les processus de production pertinents - du traitement soigneux des matières premières les plus précieuses jusqu'aux techniques de production innovantes. Nos experts expérimentés vous accompagneront étape par étape et vous enseigneront les compétences nécessaires pour réussir dans le monde de l'art de la confiserie de haute gamme. Plongez-vous dans un monde plein de créativité et de précision et profitez de l'opportunité d'élargir vos connaissances et compétences à un niveau plus élevé. Der Unternehmensbereich «Retail» umfasst über 230 Chocolaterien in über 25 Ländern. Hier bieten wir unsere Schokoladenspezialitäten an und laden Kundinnen und Kunden ein, frische Schokolade immer wieder neu zu erleben.

Du erhältst die Chance, in einer unserer Schweizer Chocolaterien eine mehrjährige EFZ-Ausbildung für den Detailhandel zu absolvieren. Dort lernst du, wie du Kundinnen und Kunden kompetent berätst, Schaufenster und Regale dekorierst und verschiedene Arbeitsabläufe organisierst. Wir machen dich mit Hygienevorschriften und Lebensmittelgesetzen vertraut und führen dich ins Bestellwesen ein.

Hast du Lust, in die Berufswelt einzusteigen und Neues zu lernen? Dann komm zu uns.

Das erwartet dich

• Du wirst beim Schritt zwischen Schule und Berufswelt von uns unterstützt und begleitet

• Du wirst individuell und persönlich durch unsere Filialleiterinnen betreut

• Du erhältst eine vielfältige, praxisorientierte Ausbildung mit sehr guten Perspektiven

Das bringst du mit

• Du liebst Schoggi

• Du hast einen Sekundarschulabchluss (A) oder einen guten Realschulabschluss (B)

• Du besitzt eine rasche Auffassungsgabe und bevorzugst ein dynamisches Umfeld

• Du magst den Kontakt zu Menschen und bist kommunikativ

• Du schätzt eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und Zuverlässigkeit

Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh.

descriptionByLocale.it: La manifattura svizzera di cioccolato Läderach produce cioccolato di alta qualità fresco. Fondato nel 1962, l'azienda familiare oggi occupa più di 2500 persone in oltre 80 paesi, con una tendenza crescente. La sede principale dell'azienda si trova nel Canton Glarus. Sulla splendida scena alpina, produciamo qui le nostre cioccolate fresche e sviluppiamo in team agili nuove idee creative. Il settore aziendale «Retail» comprende oltre 230 cioccolaterie in più di 25 paesi. Qui offriamo le nostre specialità di cioccolato e invitiamo le clienti e i clienti a scoprire nuovamente la cioccolata fresca. Hai la possibilità di svolgere un tirocinio di più anni EFZ per il dettaglio in una delle nostre cioccolaterie svizzere. Lì imparerai a consigliare le clienti e i clienti in modo competente, a decorare le vetrine e i ripiani e a organizzare diversi processi di lavoro. Ti faremo conoscere le norme di igiene e le leggi sui prodotti alimentari e ti introdurremo nel mondo degli ordini. Hai voglia di entrare nel mondo del lavoro e imparare qualcosa di nuovo? Allora vieni da noi. Ci aspetti. Sarai supportato e accompagnato nel passaggio tra scuola e mondo del lavoro. Sarai seguito e guidato individualmente e personalmente dalle nostre responsabili delle filiali. Riceverai un'istruzione varia e pratica con ottimi prospettive. Questo è ciò che porti con te. Ami il cioccolato. Hai un diploma di scuola secondaria (A) o un buon diploma di scuola reale (B). Hai una buona capacità di assimilazione e preferisci un ambiente dinamico. Ti piace il contatto con le persone e sei comunicativo. Apprezzi un lavoro meticoloso e affidabile. Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sembra interessante? Allora candidati da noi. Sonja Hottinger, responsabile degli apprendisti, al telefono +41 44 251 24 90, è a tua disposizione per eventuali domande.
descriptionByLocale.en: High-quality fresh chocolate – that's what the Swiss chocolate manufacturer Läderach stands for. Founded in 1962, the family-owned company now employs more than 2,500 people from over 80 countries, with a growing trend. The company's headquarters are located in the canton of Glarus. Against the picturesque Alpine backdrop, we produce our fresh chocolates here and develop new, creative ideas in agile teams. The company's 'Retail' department comprises over 230 chocolate shops in over 25 countries. Here, we offer our chocolate specialties and invite customers to experience fresh chocolate again and again. You will have the opportunity to complete a multi-year EFZ apprenticeship for retail in one of our Swiss chocolate shops. There, you will learn how to advise customers competently, decorate shop windows and shelves, and organize various work processes. We will familiarize you with hygiene regulations and food laws and introduce you to the world of ordering. Do you have a desire to enter the world of work and learn something new? Then come to us. That's what you can expect. You will be supported and accompanied in the transition from school to the world of work. You will be individually and personally guided by our branch managers. You will receive a diverse, practice-oriented training with excellent prospects. This is what you bring with you. You love chocolate. You have a secondary school diploma (A) or a good vocational school diploma (B). You have a quick grasp and prefer a dynamic environment. You enjoy contact with people and are communicative. You appreciate a meticulous and reliable work style. Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Sounds interesting? Then apply to us. Sonja Hottinger, apprentice supervisor, at +41 44 251 24 90, is happy to answer any questions you may have.

descriptionByLocale.fr: La chocolaterie suisse Läderach produit du chocolat de haute qualité frais. Fondée en 1962, l'entreprise familiale emploie aujourd'hui plus de 2 500 personnes dans plus de 80 pays, avec une tendance en croissance. Le siège social de l'entreprise se trouve dans le canton de Glarus. Sur le décor alpin pittoresque, nous produisons nos chocolats frais ici et développons de nouvelles idées créatives dans des équipes agiles. Le département 'Retail' de l'entreprise comprend plus de 230 chocolateries dans plus de 25 pays. Ici, nous proposons nos spécialités de chocolat et invitions les clients à découvrir à nouveau le chocolat frais. Vous aurez la possibilité de suivre un apprentissage EFZ de plusieurs années pour le détail dans l'une de nos chocolateries suisses. Là, vous apprendrez à conseiller les clients de manière compétente, à décorer les vitrines et les étagères et à organiser divers processus de travail. Nous vous familiariserons avec les réglementations d'hygiène et les lois sur les produits alimentaires et vous introduirons dans le monde des commandes. Avez-vous envie d'entrer dans le monde du travail et d'apprendre quelque chose de nouveau ? Alors venez chez nous. C'est ce que vous pouvez attendre. Vous serez soutenu et accompagné dans la transition de l'école au monde du travail. Vous serez guidé et suivi individuellement et personnellement par nos responsables de magasin. Vous recevrez une formation variée et pratique avec de bonnes perspectives. C'est ce que vous apportez avec vous. Vous aimez le chocolat. Vous avez un diplôme de l'école secondaire (A) ou un bon diplôme de l'école professionnelle (B). Vous avez une bonne capacité d'assimilation et préférez un environnement dynamique. Vous aimez le contact avec les gens et êtes communicatif. Vous appréciez un style de travail méticuleux et fiable. Own it. Grow it. Make it fresh. Cela vous intéresse ? Alors candidaturez chez nous. Sonja Hottinger, responsable des apprentis, au +41 44 251 24 90, est à votre disposition pour répondre à vos questions.
